t: 在教皇约翰二世于该月早些时候去世后,选举阿加佩图斯一世为教皇.
te: Election of pope Agapetus I following the death of pope John II earlier that month.
dz: 在教皇约翰二世于该月早些时候去世后,选举阿加佩图斯一世为教皇.
de: Election of pope Agapetus I following the death of pope John II earlier that month.

te: Byzantine general Belisarius completes the conquest of Sicily, defeating the Gothic garrison of Palermo (Panormos), and…
dz: 拜占庭将军贝利萨留击败巴勒莫（Panormos）的哥特驻军，完成对西西里岛的征服，并结束当年的执政官任期。
de: Byzantine general Belisarius completes the conquest of Sicily, defeating the Gothic garrison of Palermo (Panormos), and ending his consulship for the year.
